headword: {有給休暇|ゆうきゅうきゅうか}

definitions.gloss: paid vacation; paid leave; paid time off
definitions.explanation: Time off from work during which an employee continues to receive their regular salary. Legally mandated in Japan based on length of service.

examples.japanese: {有給休暇|ゆうきゅうきゅうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I took paid leave and went on a trip.

examples.japanese: {有給休暇|ゆうきゅうきゅうか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}り→残り：01622_nokori⟧⟦{五日|いつか}→五日：28460_itsuka⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I have five days of paid vacation left.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{有給休暇|ゆうきゅうきゅうか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{取得|しゅとく}→取得：11947_shutoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{推奨|すいしょう}している→推奨する：18699_suishousuru⟧。
examples.english: The company encourages employees to take their paid leave.

notes:
ABBREVIATIONS:
Commonly abbreviated to ⟦{有給|ゆうきゅう}→有給：04552_yuukyuu⟧ or {有休|ゆうきゅう} in casual contexts.
・「⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧{有休|ゆうきゅう}⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧」 - "I'm taking paid leave tomorrow"

COLLOCATIONS:
・{有給休暇|ゆうきゅうきゅうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ - to take paid leave
・{有給休暇|ゆうきゅうきゅうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{消化|しょうか}→消化：04200_shouka⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to use up paid leave
・{有給休暇|ゆうきゅうきゅうか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{申請|しんせい}→申請：04207_shinsei⟧ - paid leave request
・⟦{年次|ねんじ}→年次：15657_nenji⟧{有給休暇|ゆうきゅうきゅうか} - annual paid leave

LEGAL CONTEXT:
Japanese labor law requires employers to provide a minimum of 10 days of paid vacation after 6 months of continuous employment, increasing with years of service. Despite legal requirements, Japan has historically had low rates of paid leave usage.
